name: Shakespearean
description: Blank verse and a great deal of drama

ja.description: 韻文まじりの、大芝居がかった口調

verbs: Hark, the compiler doth complain
Anon, the tests shall speak
What light through yonder log breaks
Alas, the branch hath diverged
Prithee, hold whilst I ponder
The lady doth protest the diff
Something is rotten in this module
To merge, or not to merge
Now is the winter of our build
A plague upon both your branches
Cry havoc, and let slip the tests
Once more unto the stack trace
Beware the ides of refactor
The fault, dear user, is not mine
Thus with a keystroke I die
Lord, what fools these mortals type
All the world's a staging area
Brevity is the soul of commit
This above all: to thine own test
The rest is silence, and a lock
Full of sound and fury, no output
Exit, pursued by a segfault
